# The Markdown VDOM cover hides its last paragraph under the card caption

## Context

On 2026-11-20 both cold readers of the More components page (the Cold look of #21544) saw the Markdown VDOM card's caption over running text: the end of `<script>alert('nope')</script>` shows through the caption bar, and the line under the toolbar is cut in half. #21474's own cold look had already named it: the cover needs a lower edge that stays calm under the caption.

## The Problem

The cover (`devmode/markdown-14.jpg`, from the `markdown` capture recipe) is the page where its stream ends. The document ends flush with the bottom of its scrolling area, so the paragraph the cover exists for, a script tag and a `javascript:` link rendered as plain text, lands in the part of the frame a card covers with its caption. The scrolled document also runs up to the toolbar's buttons with no edge between them, so the line cut at the top reads as a rendering fault.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/component/markdown/MainContainer.mjs`: a `vbox` viewport holding a wrapping `Toolbar` and a `MarkdownVdom` (`flex: 1`) whose inline `style` is `overflow: auto; padding: 1em`.
- `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json`, recipe `markdown`: 640 × 360 from the top-left, ready once the last paragraph has rendered.
- The renewed examples draw a toolbar's edge with `color-mix(in srgb, var(--neo-color) 14%, transparent)` (`resources/css/src/examples/component/wrapper/mermaid/MainContainer.css`).

## The Fix

1. The toolbar gets that edge, and the output's styles move into `resources/css/src/examples/component/markdown/MainContainer.css`, with `6em` of room after the document.
2. Retake the cover from the unchanged recipe and publish it in neomjs/pages.

Measured on a prototype at `dev` `2e594a683b`: three captures give the same bytes (sha256 `f47e15b8…`, 101,479 bytes); the frame opens on a whole line under the toolbar's edge, and the last paragraph sits in its upper three quarters.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: In the new cover the last paragraph lies above the frame's lower quarter, and no line is cut under the toolbar.
- [ ] AC-2: Three captures from the recipe give the same bytes, and neomjs/pages serves them as `devmode/markdown-14.jpg`.
- [ ] AC-3: The PR shows the example page and the More components page before and after, at 1440 and 390.
- [ ] AC-4: The example keeps no inline style.

## Out of Scope

- The caption's own design on the Portal's cards.
- What the streamed document says.
